newsitem.title: UK: General Accident up, Warburg repeats "buy".
newsitem.headline: General Accident up, Warburg repeats "buy".

text.p: Shares in General Accident Plc moved higher on Wednesday after analysts at SBC Warburg said the stock had been oversold recently, dealers said.
The shares were up 10-1/2p to 815p by 0801 GMT. Market sources said the analysts reiterated their "buy" advice up to a share price target of 900p.
Shares in General Accident reached a peak of 872p in February before falling 10 percent over the next six weeks.
Royal & Sun Alliance Insurance Group, up 5p at 448-1/2p, was also benefiting from repeated "buy" advice, up to a target of 500p.
Analysts at the brokerage declined to comment.
